_comment: PermitIntel MCP server config for Cursor.
Replace pmit_your_key with your own key from https://permitintel.ai/trial (14 days, no card).
Two forms below. 'permitintel' is the direct remote connection and is what you want.
'permitintel-bridged' uses the mcp-remote npx bridge and is the fallback for any client build
that cannot speak streamable-http directly. Enable one, not both: two connections to the same
server means every tool appears twice in the model's tool list.
Verified against the live server 2026-10-03: 4 tools, protocol 2025-06-18.
